examples.description: Python script that reads a Hyperliquid periodic_abci_states snapshot with plain msgpack and writes the full L4 order book in the same format as hl-node compute-l4-snapshots. Works on snapshots the current hl-node cannot read. Verified order for order against hl-node on 492,491 orders.
